SYMPTOM: Safe commands (Read, grep, ls, most bash) still trigger Claude Code's terminal approval prompt even though Pixel Office classifies them as safe.

CAUSE: The pre-tool-use route returns `{}` (empty response) for auto-approved tools. Claude Code interprets empty response as 'no opinion' and falls back to its own permission system, which prompts in terminal.

FIX NEEDED: For auto-approved tools, return:
```json
{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow", "permissionDecisionReason": "Auto-approved"}}
```
This is the same format used when the browser approves — same format needed for auto-approves.

FILE: src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts
The `needsApproval: false` branch just returns `NextResponse.json({})` — change to explicit allow response.
